z6d4ck55.variantName: COSTWAY 5FT Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes LED Lights - Green
z6d4ck55.sourceDescription: Great choice to bring you a lifelike and realistic spruce Christmas tree with 450 /650warm white LED lights and 8 different lighting modes. Perfect for you to set the mood for fireside holiday gatherings and toast-filled holiday parties! The premium 600 /1250PVC branches are strong enough to support your favorite decorations to create a personalized appearance for your home, office, holiday parties, and other places. Moreover, the branches are easy to expand to get a leafy and lush appearance. The metal stand can provide reinforced support for stability. The added non-slip pads on the end of the stand protect your floor and the green painted iron pipe trunk makes this tree look more simulated. Absolutely a great gift to create a strong festive atmosphere! If you are looking for a Christmas tree like this, do not hesitate to place an order! 450/650 LED Lights with 8 Lighting Functions: The pre-lit artificial Christmas tree is equipped with 450/650 warm LED lights of energy-efficient and long-lasting to give a balanced and warm festive glow. Featuring 8 lighting functions, the lights can switch to different lighting modes, lighting up your room with a festive ambience. You just plug into the wall and enjoy the lights shine. Life-like Tree with PVC Branches: Made of high-quality PVC material, the 150/180cm Christmas tree is durable, odorless, non-flammable, and non-allergic for a long life span. Crafted with 600 /1250branch tips with exquisite workmanship, the leaves of the artificial spruce tree show a leafy and fluffy appearance and give a full look of a natural tree. Hinged Design for Easy Setting Up: Designed with the convenient hinged construction, the spruce LED Christmas tree’s body is divided into 2 sections for easy installation and you can also dismantle it for convenient storage and future uses. The branches are easy to open up all around to form a full and fluffy outlook easily. Metal Stand for Stability: Featuring a metal stand with non-slip foot pads, the pre-lit artificial Christmas tree can withstand greater support and balance, securely keeping it standing upright all season long. Moreover, the stand can be folded up to store in the closet. Also, the green-painted iron pipe of the stand makes this tree look more simulated. Perfect for Holiday Decorations: The pre-lit spruce Christmas tree boasts warm white LED lights that can brighten all your holidays. You can put it in your home, office, holiday party, and more to inspire holiday cheer and make the season feel complete. Hang on to your favorite ornaments to create a happy and prosperous festive atmosphere for you. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

y1rwf99b.sourceDescription: The ritual of Christmas begins the moment the tree goes up. This Christmas tree stands upright with lush, layered branches that feel like real pine needles—full and natural up close, like a pine brought in from the forest from a distance. The structure is sturdy and the tips are evenly spaced, so hanging ornaments is effortless—baubles, lights, small keepsakes all find their spot without searching, and the tree comes together in no time. At home, in the office, or in a shop, it becomes the place people stop at the moment they walk in. It's more than a tree. It's the first corner of winter to light up in your home—switch on the lights, let the ornaments sway, and the season arrives, filling the house with warmth. Overall Dimension: W75 x D75 x H120cm Recycle your tree through a community program where available. SYL Moda Trading LTD, Po Box 148, Manchester, M266BJ, United Kingdom

kmxg7h2h.baseName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
kmxg7h2h.variantName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
kmxg7h2h.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this realistic 5ft Christmas tree. The Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations and Christmas tree lights. Our customers love how full and bushy the Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 5ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps). Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 5ft • Number of branch tips: 1360 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 95cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green foliage • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

m3vzs0j3.variantName: Christmas Tree World Black Inflatable Mirror Ball Electric Pump
m3vzs0j3.sourceDescription: Introducing the Electric Air Pump, a practical and efficient tool designed to make inflating and deflating inflatable decorations quick and straightforward. Ideal for commercial environments, events, retail displays and home use, this pump delivers reliable airflow to inflate large decorative items with ease. When it’s time to pack away, the pump can also be used to remove air, allowing inflatables to be fully deflated and folded down for compact, space-saving storage. Compact in size and easy to operate, the Electric Air Pump is perfect for businesses and venues that need to set up and take down displays regularly. It pairs perfectly with our Inflatable Mirror Display Balls, helping you achieve professional results with minimal effort. Whether you’re preparing a seasonal display, an event installation or a large decorative feature, the Electric Air Pump is a simple, time-saving essential that makes managing inflatable décor effortless. Product Features • Use: Inflating and deflating inflatable decorations • Power: Mains powered electric pump • Performance: Fast and efficient inflation • Functionality: Can inflate and remove air for compact storage • Design: Compact and easy to store • Compatibility: Suitable for use with Inflatable Mirror Display Balls and other inflatables • Plug: UK mains plug • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

nmj04z7t.variantName: Charles Bentley Pre-Lit Snowy Red Berry and Pinecone Garland
nmj04z7t.sourceDescription: Add a festive flourish to your home with this 180cm long pre-lit garland, adorned with snow-dusted green foliage, red berries, and pinecones it's perfect for draping over mantels, staircases, and doorways. The realistic branches offer a full, textured look, while warm white plug-in LED lights bring a soft, wintry glow to any space. Whether styled on its own or paired with matching frosted pieces, this garland makes it easy to create a coordinated Christmas display. Simple to position and built for reuse year after year, it's a timeless decorative piece you'll enjoy for many seasons to come. Please Note: Best for indoor use and protected areas. The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look. This garland requires 3x AA batteries. Features: • Pre lit branches • Lightweight • Mixture of realistic branches • 133 tips for full effect • 50 warm white LEDs Includes: • 1x pre-lit garland Materials: • Plastic Dimensions: W180, D44cm Not for children under 3 years Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
